behaviors.description: Sign imported bundle while selecting summary and AppStream updates.
behaviors.preconditions: Independent reference bundle and disposable key.
behaviors.expected: Signature verifies, summary absent and AppStream branch exists.

behaviors.description: Select a named image from independent multi-image OCI layout.
behaviors.preconditions: Reference OCI layout containing distinct A and B images supplied by prepare_options.
behaviors.expected: Only requested B branch appears with exact B payload bytes.

behaviors.description: Export OCI layout with nondefault zstd compression.
behaviors.expected: OCI layout/index/manifest and digest-valid blobs with zstd media types and magic.

behaviors.description: Create delta bundle based on A.
behaviors.preconditions: Independent B repository containing A parent.
behaviors.expected: Independent delta inspector identifies exact A base and B target.

behaviors.description: Select alternate app when bundling two architectures.
behaviors.preconditions: Independent repo containing distinct native and alternate commits.
behaviors.expected: Independent OSTree application of bundle yields known alternate commit.

behaviors.description: Create an application bundle from an independent repository.
behaviors.preconditions: Reference A distribution repo; runtime preinstalled before bundle installation.
behaviors.expected: Bundle installs exact A app commit.

behaviors.description: Create a runtime bundle with explicit architecture.
Create a bundle carrying its update URL.
behaviors.preconditions: Reference A repository and preinstalled runtime.
behaviors.expected: Exact app commit installed with an origin whose URL matches --repo-url.

behaviors.preconditions: prepare_build supplies reference-created A app bundle.
behaviors.expected: Public repository ref resolves to A and all objects pass OSTree fsck.
